purpose: Answers patients' scheduling questions for one clinic: finds the patient, reads and reschedules or cancels appointments, tells them their balance.

regulations.HIPAA minimum necessary (45 CFR 164.502(: Reads identity and contact fields only. No SSN, insurance ID, diagnosis or clinical notes.
regulations.Row scope: Only Riverside Downtown (clinicId 1). Other clinics' patients are not in its result set.
regulations.PCI DSS Req 7 (need to know): Sees the balance on the billing account; never sees card data. paymentMethods is not granted at all.
